latestRun.summary: Evidence refresh added 0 confirmed and 20 flagged-provisional result packages, applied 8 unique existing-record updates, quarantined 4 candidates, excluded 60, and brought the corpus to 3591 source packages.
changes: Added flagged-provisional ID 3561 for The equivalence of topological indices for U(1)⋊Z2-symmetric quantum spin chains. The source reports: Proves equivalence of the Ogata operator-algebraic index and Tasaki twist index for the stated integer-spin-chain setting, via a strong-limit half-chain rotation construction and an exact commutator identity with an explicit error bound. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34119v1. Further checking: Obtain specialist review of the proof and novelty; verify the exact Ogata/Tasaki hypotheses and application; reconstruct the author/model contribution boundary from any retained transcript. No proof was independently checked here.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3562 for Hitting Sets for Polynomials with Small Partial Derivative Spaces. The source reports: Gives an explicit polynomial-size hitting set in characteristic zero for polynomials whose partial-derivative space has small dimension, with an application to depth-three powering circuits. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34436v1. Further checking: Independently check the PIT/algebraic-complexity proof, quantitative parameters and novelty; inspect the underlying transcript and map model versus human contributions. No artifact was executed.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3563 for The complexity of computing the covering radius of a Euclidean lattice. The source reports: Establishes completeness of the Euclidean-lattice covering-radius problem for the second level of the polynomial hierarchy. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35027v1. Further checking: Have a complexity/lattice specialist verify the reductions, promise/gap and bit-complexity details and priority; identify the exact model and contribution trace.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3564 for Peppy: An AI-Assisted Workflow for Tight Convergence Analysis of Optimization Algorithms. The source reports: Reports analytic tight convergence bounds resolving the stated Taylor-et-al. conjectures for FGM and OGM and related rational FGM/FISTA cases (Theorems 5.1–5.5). Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35762v1. Further checking: Independently verify all five theorem statements, tightness and novelty; safely inspect but do not execute notebooks or symbolic checks; produce a theorem-level contribution map.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3565 for Solver Agent: an Agentic AI Framework for Theoretical Physics Computations Applied to F-theory Uplifts of O3-planes and S-folds. The source reports: Reports sufficient conditions for global F-theory Weierstrass uplifts with terminal quotient singularities and associated correction formulae/local D3 charges, including the stated broader Jefferson–Kim-conjecture result. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35958v1. Further checking: Obtain algebraic-geometry/string-theory review of Theorem 4.2 and all hypotheses, novelty and formulae; inspect session artifacts without executing them and map exact human/model roles.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3566 for Infrared Subtraction with Artificial Intelligence. The source reports: Develops and demonstrates an AI-assisted local infrared-subtraction/P2B+EFT construction, including explicit fixed-Born maps/contact formulae and NLO three- and four-jet reconstruction; proposed NNLO extensions are not counted as completed results. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36007v1. Further checking: Restrict any publication row to demonstrated NLO/general-map results; obtain independent physics review and numerical reproduction; check novelty and exact model/human allocation. Do not count proposed NNLO work.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3567 for Bouncing-ball modes in ergodic billiards. The source reports: Shows that for almost every horizontal stretch in the stated billiard family there are eigenfunctions concentrating in the rectangular region, while an open parameter set remains ergodic. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36501v1. Further checking: Have a spectral-theory specialist verify the quasimode argument, parameter hypotheses and novelty, and reconstruct the exact author/model boundary.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3568 for Coding Agents for Coding Theory. The source reports: Reports E4(6,3)≥120 and twelve additional improvements to lower bounds for edit-distance codes. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39081v1. Further checking: Independently run separately authored verifiers/search in a controlled review, check all tables and priority, and distinguish classical search methodology from agent-generated engineering.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3569 for Efficient Online Inverse Optimization with O(d) Regret. The source reports: Gives a deterministic proper anytime online inverse-optimization algorithm with O(d) regret, uniform over the horizon, and O(d²) work per round. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13440v1. Further checking: Independently review the proof, constants and novelty; separate the Cogentic core from later human extensions; verify model/version and retained run evidence.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3570 for Prediction with Expert Advice: Anytime Regret with Many Experts Matches the Fixed-Time Constant. The source reports: Provides an anytime prediction-with-expert-advice regret bound whose leading constant asymptotically matches the fixed-time constant in the stated many-expert regime. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.27206v1. Further checking: Independently verify the regret proof, regime, constant and novelty; identify the exact model/version and retained run evidence.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3571 for Improved Revenue Guarantees for Selling Separately and Bundling. The source reports: Proves OPT≤3.52·max(SREV,BREV) for the stated multi-item revenue setting, improving the earlier 5.2 guarantee. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.28873v1. Further checking: Obtain independent mechanism-design review of the proof and numerical constant, check priority, and verify model/version and retained run evidence.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3572 for The Power of Recruiting the Smaller Side: Two Additional Traders Suffice in Two-Sided Markets. The source reports: Shows that recruiting two additional traders on the smaller side suffices for the stated two-sided-market guarantee, while one does not under the stated DSIC/IR/WBB constraints. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.27304v1. Further checking: Independently verify both the upper and lower bounds and all mechanism assumptions; check novelty, exact model/version and retained run evidence.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3573 for Shuffle squares in smooth binary words and the Kolakoski sequence. The source reports: Proves the stated shuffle-square theorem for smooth even-Parikh binary words of length at least 18, enumerates 34 shorter exceptions, and derives the stated Kolakoski consequences. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02262v1. Further checking: Independently verify the combinatorial proof, exception certificate and Kolakoski deductions; check novelty and the human/model split. Do not execute the supplied verifier without controlled review.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3574 for Sparse coloring for isosceles-free grids: an AI-assisted proof case study. The source reports: Proves C(n)=Ω(n·sqrt(log log n/log n)) for the stated isosceles-free grid coloring problem. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04194v1. Further checking: Verify applicability of the cited hypergraph-coloring result and all degree/codegree counts, check novelty and finite/asymptotic scope, and reconstruct the contribution trace.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3575 for Symmetry and AI-assisted discovery of magic-state factories. The source reports: Reports a classified catalog of 699 factory classes (564 described as new), explicit leading factories, and the stated smallest-known pure-T factory with suppression exponent below one. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06535v1. Further checking: Independently reproduce the catalog and verifier results, compare with prior archives, verify the leading/smallest claims, and map agent suggestions to each retained construction. Do not execute downloaded code here.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3576 for Large Language Model-Guided Discovery of Weight-Five Bivariate Bicycle Codes. The source reports: Reports 1,142 weight-five bivariate-bicycle-code proposals, 1,081 attributed to LLM-generated programs, with exact connected CSS realizations and the stated strongest PBB example [[216,4,10]]. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06623v1. Further checking: Independently rerun exact distance/connectivity checks, compare against archive and random-search controls, verify all counts and priority, and produce a program/result-level contribution map.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3577 for An FPRAS for Counting Common Bases of Two Matroids. The source reports: Gives the first claimed FPRAS for counting common bases of two matroids and almost-uniform sampling in the stated oracle setting, via generalized Hadamard-product measures. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06724v1. Further checking: Obtain independent algorithms/probability review of the proof, runtime and oracle guarantees; check novelty and reconstruct the model/human contribution split.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3578 for Erdős 1054: sums of smallest divisors. The source reports complete Lean proofs of all three answers to Erdős problem 1054 for the least f(n) representable as a sum of the k smallest divisors: f(n) is not o(n), is not o(n) on any natural-density-one subtype, and limsup f(n)/n is infinite even on every density-one subtype. It additionally reports a uniform lower-density bound c/[A^3(1+log A)^4] for odd n with f(n)>An, an O(delta^3 X) small-ratio upper bound, zero liminf on represented integers, and a two-way density equivalence with even aliquot values. Primary source: https://data.palomar-registry.org/entries/PALOMAR-2026-10-05-000005-v1.json. Further checking: independently review all 21 formal theorems and their definitions, the Goldbach bridge, second-moment and Tao–Kovač bounds; establish novelty/priority and separate new quantitative claims from adapted Principia results; obtain the exact model and claim-level AI/human allocation; and independently replay the pinned Lean package and check statement correspondence. Keep provisional=1, unreviewed, low/conservative confidence, and no strict-policy Superhuman override.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3579 for The rank-one Dixmier conjecture for elements of mass at most six. The source reports that over every characteristic-zero field, if P and Q in the first Weyl algebra satisfy QP-PQ=1 and P has at most six nonzero homogeneous components for the grading deg X=1 and deg Y=-1, then P and Q generate the algebra; Q is not restricted in degree, order or mass. Primary source: https://data.palomar-registry.org/entries/PALOMAR-2026-10-05-000006-v2.json. Further checking: obtain and review a stable manuscript that was public by the cutoff; independently verify the Weyl-algebra mathematics, novelty/priority against Guccione–Guccione–Valqui and related work, the absence of hidden bounds on Q, and formal-statement correspondence; obtain exact Codex/human allocation; and independently replay the pinned Lean package. Keep provisional=1, unreviewed, low/conservative confidence, and no strict-policy Superhuman override.

Added flagged-provisional ID 3580 for AI-assisted formal audit and corrected statements for Markman’s Weil-classes paper. The source reports: The maintainer reports an AI-produced formal audit of arXiv:2502.03415v2 that identifies eleven statements as false or misprinted as printed and formalizes the closest corrected versions: Proposition 1.3.1; the odd-n case of Lemma 2.2.1; the Spin/GL image claim; Remark 2.2.5; signs in Remark 2.3.1 and Lemma 6.3.2; equation (8.1.2), which needs End_Q(X)=Q; the involution and a coefficient in section 8.1; a group in Lemma 2.2.2; and Remark 10.1.2(1) for d=0. The source also reports a misprinted basis in Example 10.2.2, documents wrong proof steps and named gaps, supplies corrected or alternative arguments, and says none of these changes affects Theorems 1.4.1 or 1.5.1 or Corollary 1.6.1. Primary source: https://data.palomar-registry.org/entries/PALOMAR-2026-10-05-000007-v1.json. Further checking: obtain independent human/specialist review of each of the eleven corrected statements, the additional basis misprint, every claimed proof error/gap and the claim that the main results are unaffected; verify source-TeX and Lean-statement correspondence and the conditional model boundaries; determine novelty/priority and whether findings were communicated to or accepted by Eyal Markman; obtain claim-level human/Claude allocation; and independently replay the pinned package. Keep provisional=1, unreviewed, low/conservative confidence, and no strict-policy Superhuman override.
